The slowest part of running an LLM just got 6x faster without losing a single token.

DFlash is a new open-source speculative decoding framework.

It uses a block diffusion drafter that predicts multiple tokens at once.

→ 6x lossless speed boost
→ 2.5x faster than EAGLE-3
→ Works with vLLM, SGLang, MLX

Supports Qwen, LLaMA, and Gemma.
